exit_criteria: A real trained artifact exists; no placeholder or synthetic weight file.
Exact artifact byte size is recorded.
Artifact SHA-256 is recorded before upload.
Training/runtime/config provenance is bound to the artifact.
Optimizer/recurrent state is separately identified when required for reproducibility.
Upload occurs to the intended Hugging Face repository/revision.
Remote artifact is re-read or downloaded and SHA-256/size are verified against the pre-upload record.
A distribution receipt is produced and human promotion remains separate from technical verification.
